controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:55.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:55.500Z"
| WHERE host.name == "db-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed*")
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY message
| SORT total DESC
| LIMIT 50
